messages:
nina (People Ops): Quick sync: senior leadership wants a pilot 'Manager Micro-Spot' program for July — managers can issue on-the-spot $50 recognitions up to 3x per manager per quarter. Need ops checklist: tax/payroll tagging, nom flow, comms, and a thin audit trail. Ideas?
omar (People Ops): Love it. Low friction. We should require a 1-line rationale and a manager checkbox confirming it's not performance correction. Also need a simple CSV export for audit.
tess (Comp & Benefits): Tax note: $50 cash-equivalents are often taxable. If we do e-gift cards, payroll still needs a code to flag taxation in US/UK. I can draft the payroll tagging mapping.
liam (Engineering Manager): From manager POV, rubber-stamping should be quick. Maybe a modal in the manager dashboard with pre-filled nominee details + 1-line reason. Also a cap reminder.
iris (Office Ops): If manager opts for physical token (sticker + enamel pin) in-office, we can batch ship pins monthly. Cost request: pins ~ $1 each in bulk. That avoids card issuance for in-office folks.
nina (People Ops): Ops checklist:
- finalize tax/payroll tagging rules (Tess)
- decide delivery modes: e-gift, payroll bonus, physical token (Iris)
- build 1-click manager flow + audit log (Omar)
- comms draft for managers + internal FAQ (Nina)
- pilot cohort: 25 managers, 7/01-9/30
- reporting: weekly CSV of awards

omar (People Ops): I'll scope the manager flow prototype. UX: modal -> confirm -> optional note -> auto-email to nominee (cc manager) -> record in People Ops DB. Low friction.
tess (Comp & Benefits): I'll coordinate with payroll on mapping codes: EGC (e-gift card) vs PTK (physical token). Will also flag taxability per country. Expect note by Wed.
liam (Engineering Manager): Can we add a 'one-time manager override' field for edge cases? Prefer admin approval for overrides to prevent misuse.
nina (People Ops): Agree. Add approval queue for overrides (1-2 people).
iris (Office Ops): For physical tokens, timeline: order pins by June 10 for July rollout. Packing volunteers optional. I'll own vendor sourcing.
spotlight-bot: Reminder: pilot kickoff meeting scheduled 2027-06-22 15:00 UTC.
omar (People Ops): Quick Q on reporting: should weekly CSV include manager notes? privacy concerns?
tess (Comp & Benefits): Include only manager name, nominee name, award type, country code, amount, and admin tags. Exclude free-text reasons from CSV; store them in secure logs for audit.
liam (Engineering Manager): Sounds reasonable. Managers need an example template to announce program to teams.
nina (People Ops): I'll draft manager announcement template and short FAQ. Proposed launch comms timeline: managers informed week of June 20, pilot live July 1. Please confirm owners: Tess=payroll mapping, Omar=manager flow, Iris=tokens, Nina=comms + pilot ops.
tess (Comp & Benefits): Confirmed. I'll post mapping and tax blurb by Tue.
omar (People Ops): Confirmed. Will share prototype link for feedback by Fri.
iris (Office Ops): Confirmed. Will share vendor quotes by Mon.
liam (Engineering Manager): I'll volunteer a couple of managers for pilot cohort.
nina (People Ops): Great. Closing note: keep the process lightweight. We want quick moments of appreciation, minimal admin. Thanks team! :sparkles:
